children: First United raised its cash dividend by 8% to 28 cents a share from 26 cents.
The new payout, equal to $1.12 a year, represents an annual yield of 2.6% based on Wednesday's closing price of $42.76.
The parent company of First United Bank & Trust said Wednesday the new dividend will be payable on Nov. 2 to shareholders of record as of Oct. 19.
